patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with a large lifestyle image on one side and a prominent headline and CTA on the other, featuring an overlaid information card.
Consistent use of a vibrant lime green as the primary accent color, contrasting sharply with dark text and white backgrounds to create a fresh and modern feel.
Distinctive full-width sections with varied background colors (white, light green, dark green, black) to clearly delineate content blocks and provide visual rhythm.
Bold, large sans-serif headings for impact, paired with a more neutral, readable sans-serif for body text, creating a clear and accessible typographic hierarchy.
No scroll-triggered motion observable from the provided static screenshots. The page relies on static content presentation and clear visual hierarchy.

technique_notes: The site employs a clean, modular layout with full-width sections that use varying background colors to visually separate content blocks and guide the user's eye.
Information is presented in digestible card-based layouts, often in grids, featuring clear icons and concise text to convey benefits and features efficiently.

The hero section uses an asymmetrical split, combining a large, engaging lifestyle image with a prominent headline and call-to-action, enhanced by an overlaid information card that appears to be a dynamic element.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and input fields, maintaining a soft but modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing with airy sections, particularly in the hero, transitioning to a more dense but still readable layout in feature grids and pricing tables.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant lime green as a primary accent color immediately grabs attention and gives it a fresh, energetic feel that stands out from typical financial services sites. The asymmetrical hero layout with its large, engaging image and overlaid information card is also a unique and effective design choice.
